description: Phase 43 — Research-Backed Capability Upgrades: Market Regime Detector, Adaptive Exit Strategy Manager, Enhanced Confidence Calibration. These are ACTUAL FEATURE IMPROVEMENTS (not test-only) based on web research across 6 axes: regime detection (BOCPD, HMM, Hurst), exit strategies (Chandelier, partial profit, volatility-adjusted trailing), confidence calibration (ensemble disagreement, Platt scaling, regime-aware), portfolio risk (DCC-GARCH, correlation netting), adaptive sizing (Kelly, streak-aware), and Bayesian consensus. Delivered: 3 new production modules (~91KB source) + 175 tests.

userStories.title: Market Regime Detector module with BOCPD + Hurst/ADX hybrid
userStories.description: New src/scanner/regime_detector.py implementing: (1) Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection for real-time regime shift alerts, (2) Hurst exponent for trending vs mean-reverting classification, (3) ADX for trend strength confirmation, (4) Volatility regime clustering via ATR percentile bands, (5) Ensemble consensus across all signals. Produces RegimeDetectionResult dataclass with regime_index, confidence, changepoint_probability, hurst, adx, and next_regime_probs.
acceptanceCriteria: RegimeDetector class with update() and get_regime() methods
BOCPD implementation with configurable hazard_rate and threshold
Hurst exponent calculation with configurable window (50-200 bars)
ADX trend strength classification
Ensemble consensus producing regime_index 0-3 with confidence score
All pure-Python (no TF dependency), works with numpy/scipy only
At least 30 unit tests covering all components
userStories.notes: 43 tests passing. 794-line module with 5 algorithms: BOCPD (Adams & MacKay), Hurst R/S analysis, ADX, ATR percentile clustering, ensemble consensus. Outputs RegimeDetectionResult with strategy_hint and risk_multiplier.

userStories.title: Adaptive Exit Strategy Manager with Chandelier + Partial Profit + Time Decay
userStories.description: New src/scanner/adaptive_exits.py implementing: (1) Chandelier Exit (ATR-based trailing stop from highest high), (2) Partial profit taking (scale-out at 1R/1.5R/2R), (3) Volatility-adjusted trailing stop (regime-dependent multipliers), (4) Time-based exit backstop (regime-dependent holding period limits), (5) Confidence-decay exit trigger. Produces ExitAction dataclass with action type, reason, and parameters.
acceptanceCriteria: AdaptiveExitManager class with evaluate_exit() method
Chandelier Exit with configurable period and ATR multiplier
Partial profit scale-out with configurable tranche ratios and R-levels
Volatility-adjusted trailing stop with regime-dependent multipliers
Time-based exit with regime-dependent holding period limits
Confidence-decay trigger using calibrated confidence threshold
At least 30 unit tests covering all exit strategies
userStories.notes: 80 tests passing. 5 exit strategies with priority merging (confidence_decay > time > chandelier > vol_trail > partial). Stateless evaluation via TradeContext. 3 factory functions (default/conservative/aggressive).

userStories.title: Enhanced Confidence Calibration with regime-awareness and ensemble disagreement
userStories.description: New src/scanner/confidence_calibration.py implementing: (1) Ensemble disagreement metric from 12 agent scores, (2) Regime-aware Platt scaling (separate calibration curves per regime), (3) Confidence time-decay with regime-dependent rates, (4) Agent agreement quality score, (5) Meta-confidence (confidence in the calibration itself). Produces CalibratedConfidence dataclass.
acceptanceCriteria: ConfidenceCalibrationSystem class with calibrate() method
Ensemble disagreement calculation from agent verdict scores
Regime-aware Platt scaling with per-regime sigmoid parameters
Confidence time-decay with configurable per-regime decay rates
Agent agreement quality metric (std of agent scores)
Meta-confidence score based on calibration sample size and recency
At least 30 unit tests covering all calibration components
userStories.notes: 31 tests passing. 881-line module with 5-layer calibration: ensemble disagreement (4-level: LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL), regime-aware Platt scaling, time-decay, agent agreement, meta-confidence. Atomic JSON persistence.

userStories.title: Integration tests: Regime → Exits → Calibration pipeline
userStories.description: Integration tests verifying the full pipeline: RegimeDetector output feeds into AdaptiveExitManager and ConfidenceCalibrationSystem. Tests verify data flow, edge cases (regime transitions mid-trade, confidence decay to exit threshold), and consistency of outputs.
